query: Consider the following context: The combination of elevated temperature and tribo-corrosion leads to the accelerated degradation of structural components used in many extreme environments. Recently developed high-entropy alloys (HEAs) with multiple principal elements have the potential for superior degradation resistance compared with presently used structural alloys. In that context, which material can be used for superior tribo-corrosion degradation resistance, and why?

generation.hypothesis: High-entropy alloys with a mix of Fe, Cr, Ni, and Co as principal elements will exhibit superior tribo-corrosion degradation resistance compared to conventional stainless steel alloys.
generation.material_initial_state: Polished surface finish with a roughness of 0.1 μm
generation.intervention: Sliding wear test under corrosive environment with 0.5 M NaCl solution at 80°C
generation.conditions: Normal load of 10 N, sliding speed of 0.1 m/s, and test duration of 1000 minutes
generation.structural_mediator: Formation of a stable, adherent oxide layer
generation.mechanism: The high entropy of mixing in the alloy leads to the formation of a stable, adherent oxide layer, which reduces the rate of corrosion and wear
generation.predicted_outcome: A reduction in wear rate of at least 30% and a decrease in corrosion current density of at least 25% compared to conventional stainless steel alloys
generation.boundary: Wear rate < 1.2 × 10^-4 mm³/Nm and corrosion current density < 1.5 × 10^-6 A/cm²
generation.uncertainty: The actual performance of the high-entropy alloy may vary depending on the specific composition, processing history, and testing conditions

falsification_experiment.design: Sliding wear test under corrosive environment with varying normal loads and sliding speeds
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the wear rate of the high-entropy alloy is not at least 30% lower than that of the conventional stainless steel alloy, or if the corrosion current density is not at least 25% lower, then the hypothesis is falsified
